cues.en: So, at this point, we've set up config.py, and all this does, of course, is load our
cues.zh: 目前已完成 config.py，它的功能當然就是載入

cues.en: configuration and return a configuration, so we return a class of type config.
cues.zh: 設定，並回傳設定，也就是回傳 Config 型別的實例。

cues.en: You might be asking yourself, how come this entry, openAI.baseURL, is equal to either what's in baseURL.raw or none, and the answer is very simple.
cues.zh: 你可能會問：為什麼 openai_base_url 這一項，要設成 base_url_raw 的內容或 None？答案很簡單。

cues.en: It's different than the API key or the chat model because, since we're using openAI's SDK, if you don't specify the baseURL, it defaults to openAI's, and that's the only
cues.zh: 它跟 API 金鑰和聊天模型不同，是因為我們使用 OpenAI SDK；沒有指定 base_url 時，預設就會使用 OpenAI 的網址，而這正是

cues.en: reason this one is different than these two.
cues.zh: 這項設定和另外兩項不同的唯一原因。

cues.en: Now, let's turn our attention to LLM.py and set up the code to actually work with an LLM, and again, this is very simple.
cues.zh: 接著來處理 llm.py，寫出實際與 LLM 互動的程式碼。同樣地，這也很簡單。

cues.en: So I'll do my imports, as I always do, so again, I'm going to say from future, I'm going to import annotations.
cues.zh: 一如往常先匯入需要的項目。再次從 __future__ 匯入 annotations。

cues.en: I'm going to use those.
cues.zh: 之後會使用這些標註。

cues.en: And then we want to use something called iterator.
cues.zh: 接著需要一個叫做 Iterator 的型別。

cues.en: We want to have an iterator available, and that's pretty easy.
cues.zh: 我們希望能使用迭代器，這很容易。

cues.en: So from collections.abc, we'll import iterator, iterator right there, okay? Try that again.
cues.zh: 所以從 collections.abc 匯入 Iterator，就在這裡。重新輸入一次，

cues.en: Import iterator. That's better.
cues.zh: import Iterator，這樣就對了。

cues.en: So we need to have an iterator, and we'll be seeing that shortly, and I also want a particular type, okay?
cues.zh: 我們需要迭代器，稍後就會看到用途；另外還需要某種型別。

cues.en: I want to have a typed dictionary, and that's really easy to get as well.
cues.zh: 我要使用有型別定義的字典，取得方式也很簡單。

cues.en: We'll just go to from typing, which is right available in our Python.
cues.zh: 直接從 Python 內建的 typing，

cues.en: We'll import, and we'll call it type checking, first of all, and we'll also import typed,
cues.zh: 先匯入 TYPE_CHECKING，另外再匯入 TypedDict，

cues.en: type dict, T-Y-P-E-D, dict, for type dictionary, okay?
cues.zh: 拼字是 T-Y-P-E-D，再接 Dict，代表有型別定義的字典。

cues.en: We'll be using those.
cues.zh: 之後會用到它們。

cues.en: And then we need our openAI model.
cues.zh: 接著需要 OpenAI 的模型用戶端。

cues.en: So from openAI, we'll import openAI, with a capital O and a capital AI, okay?
cues.zh: 所以從 openai 匯入 OpenAI，名稱的 O、A、I 都是大寫。

cues.en: And then we'll just have a little if statement right here.
cues.zh: 然後在這裡加上一個小型 if 判斷。

cues.en: If type checking, if that's available, then we'll say from.config, we'll import config, okay?
cues.zh: 如果 TYPE_CHECKING 為真，就從 .config 匯入 Config。

cues.en: So there's our imports. Easy enough.
cues.zh: 匯入項目就完成了，很簡單。

cues.en: Now, the first thing we'll do is we'll set up a class, and the class we're going to call message.
cues.zh: 首先建立一個類別，命名為 Message。

cues.en: This will be the type that we actually send to and receive from the LLM messages, okay?
cues.zh: 這是實際傳送給 LLM 以及從 LLM 接收的訊息型別，

cues.en: So individual parts of a conversation.
cues.zh: 也就是對話中的各個訊息。

cues.en: And that's going to take a typed dict, okay? Okay?
cues.zh: 它會繼承 TypedDict。

cues.en: Now let's set this up.
cues.zh: 現在來定義它。

cues.en: It's very short.
cues.zh: 內容很短，

cues.en: We only have two entries.
cues.zh: 只有兩個欄位。

cues.en: We're going to have something called role, which is a string, and we're going to have something called content, which is also a string, okay?
cues.zh: 第一個叫 role，型別是 str；第二個叫 content，也同樣是 str。

cues.en: Now what are those?
cues.zh: 這兩個欄位代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, role, that describes one of three possibilities.
cues.zh: role 會是三種角色之一。

cues.en: When you send a chat to or receive a chat from an LLM, you're always going to have a role.
cues.zh: 與 LLM 傳送或接收聊天訊息時，都一定會有角色。

cues.en: And the obvious ones are the user, that's the human, that's the human's message, or the assistant.
cues.zh: 最明顯的兩種是 user，也就是人類使用者的訊息，以及 assistant，

cues.en: And of course, that's what you're talking to, the LLM.
cues.zh: 也就是你正在對話的 LLM。

cues.en: But there's a third kind called system, and that's never seen by the user.
cues.zh: 但還有第三種叫做 system，使用者不會看到它。

cues.en: So if a message has the role system, those are instructions to the model that shape how it behaves.
cues.zh: 所以角色是 system 的訊息，就是用來塑造模型行為的指示。

cues.en: You can say, respond in this kind of conversational tone.
cues.zh: 例如，可以要求它用某種口吻回答，

cues.en: Never do this sort of thing.
cues.zh: 永遠不要做某些事情，

cues.en: You are a, that sort of instruction you're going to pass to the LLM, okay?
cues.zh: 或告訴它「你是一位……」，把這類指示傳給 LLM。

cues.en: And the content is just the content of the message itself.
cues.zh: content 則單純是訊息本身的內容。

cues.en: So that's easy enough.
cues.zh: 這很容易理解。

cues.en: Now we're going to need another class called the chat client, class chat client.
cues.zh: 接著需要另一個類別 ChatClient，寫 class ChatClient。

cues.en: And of course, that's what's actually used to communicate with the LLM, okay?
cues.zh: 它就是實際負責與 LLM 溝通的類別。

cues.en: Now we will have an init function for this, def underscore, underscore, underscore, init, underscore, underscore, okay?
cues.zh: 我們會為它建立初始化函式：def __init__。

cues.en: And that's going to take, as you almost always do with classes, self.
cues.zh: 和大多數類別一樣，第一個參數是 self，

cues.en: That's the first parameter.
cues.zh: 它是第一個參數。

cues.en: It will also take the base URL, okay?
cues.zh: 另外還需要 base_url，

cues.en: And that's going to be a string, or it can be none.
cues.zh: 型別是 str，也可以是 None。

cues.en: If we're talking to chat GPT servers, we don't need to specify that, okay?
cues.zh: 如果連接 ChatGPT 伺服器，就不必指定它。

cues.en: We'll also need the API key.
cues.zh: 還需要 api_key。

cues.en: We have to have that just to use the OpenAI client, and that's a string.
cues.zh: 只要使用 OpenAI 用戶端，就必須提供這個字串。

cues.en: And we also need to know what model are we talking to, Gemma 3 or something like that, okay?
cues.zh: 另外要知道連接的是哪個模型，例如 Gemma 3。

cues.en: And that's just a string, the name of the model.
cues.zh: 它也是個字串，也就是模型的名稱。

cues.en: And this doesn't return anything, so none, okay?
cues.zh: 這個函式不回傳內容，因此回傳型別標註為 None。

cues.en: So there's the signature, and there's only two entries in here.
cues.zh: 這樣函式簽章就完成了，裡面只需要兩項設定。

cues.en: First of all, what's the client?
cues.zh: 首先是用戶端，

cues.en: So we'll say self.underscore client, okay?
cues.zh: 寫 self._client，

cues.en: That's going to be equal to, write that again, OpenAI, that one we just imported, with base
cues.zh: 它等於——重新輸入——OpenAI，也就是剛才匯入的類別，其中 base_url

cues.en: URL equal to whatever base URL is set to, and with the API key equal to API key, okay?
cues.zh: 設為傳入的 base_url，api_key 也設為傳入的 api_key。

cues.en: So we have to have that.
cues.zh: 所以需要這一項。

cues.en: And we also want to set the model, self, write that again, self.underscore model.
cues.zh: 另外還要設定模型，寫 self._model。

cues.en: And that's going to be equal to whatever our model is, which we get as a call to this function, okay?
cues.zh: 它的值就是呼叫這個函式時傳入的 model。

cues.en: So that's the init function, so we have to have that.
cues.zh: 初始化函式就完成了，這是必要的。

cues.en: And now we want a class method.
cues.zh: 接著需要一個類別方法。

cues.en: So I'll use annotations and say class method, okay?
cues.zh: 所以使用 @classmethod 裝飾器。

cues.en: And I'm going to have a def from underscore config.
cues.zh: 再定義 def from_config，

cues.en: We're going to set things from our config.
cues.zh: 用設定物件來建立用戶端。

cues.en: The first argument I'll just call CLS, okay?
cues.zh: 第一個參數我就叫做 cls，

cues.en: And the second one is CFG, and we're going to type in that to config.
cues.zh: 第二個是 cfg，型別標註為 Config。

cues.en: And that's going to return chat client, right there, okay?
cues.zh: 回傳型別是 ChatClient。

cues.en: This is just a convenience method, a convenience constructor.
cues.zh: 這只是個方便使用的方法，也就是便捷的建構方式，

cues.en: Pull the arguments that are required from our config.
cues.zh: 從設定物件中取出需要的參數。

cues.en: So return CLS, and we're going to use CFG, the config.openai base URL, right there.
cues.zh: 因此回傳 cls，傳入 cfg.openai_base_url，

cues.en: And CFG.openai API key, and CFG.chat model, okay?
cues.zh: 再傳入 cfg.openai_api_key 和 cfg.chat_model。

cues.en: So just a convenience class method.
cues.zh: 它就是這樣一個方便的類別方法。

cues.en: And then we'll have another function called stream.
cues.zh: 接著建立另一個叫做 stream 的函式，

cues.en: And this is the actual chat itself, okay?
cues.zh: 這才是真正進行聊天的部分。

cues.en: So again, it takes self, and it also needs a messages.
cues.zh: 它同樣接收 self，另外還需要 messages，

cues.en: That's going to be a list of messages.
cues.zh: 也就是訊息串列。

cues.en: So we'll type in it to a list of message, right there, a type we just set up, okay?
cues.zh: 所以型別標註為 list[Message]，使用剛才定義的型別。

cues.en: And it's going to return an iterator of strings, okay?
cues.zh: 回傳值則是字串的迭代器。

cues.en: So we imported that type iterator, and we're going to use it right here.
cues.zh: 我們之前匯入 Iterator 型別，就是要在這裡使用。

cues.en: And then, of course, our colon.
cues.zh: 最後加上冒號。

cues.en: Now, what is this for?
cues.zh: 這有什麼用途？

cues.en: We're going to return an iterator rather than a list because we want to be able to show the chat as it's coming in.
cues.zh: 我們回傳迭代器而不是串列，是希望聊天內容一傳進來就能顯示。

cues.en: We don't want to wait for the, you ask a question to the LLM, it thinks for a while, and then it returns a huge chunk of text or images or something like that.
cues.zh: 不想讓使用者問完後，等 LLM 思考一陣子，再一次回傳一大塊文字、圖片等內容。

cues.en: We want it to show as it's being streamed to us, okay?
cues.zh: 我們要在串流接收的同時就顯示出來。

cues.en: So to make that happen, we need to have a stream, a variable name I'm choosing right now.
cues.zh: 為了做到這一點，先建立一個變數 stream，這個名字是我現在取的。

cues.en: That's going to be equal to self.
cues.zh: 它的值來自 self。

cues.en: And now we use our SDK from OpenAI.
cues.zh: 現在開始使用 OpenAI SDK。

cues.en: So our SDK is stored in a client, right there, underscore client, okay?
cues.zh: SDK 用戶端存放在這裡的 _client，

cues.en: And that client has something called chat available.
cues.zh: 這個用戶端具有 chat，

cues.en: That's a property, okay?
cues.zh: 它是一個屬性。

cues.en: And that chat has something called completions.
cues.zh: chat 裡面還有 completions，

cues.en: That's another property.
cues.zh: 那也是一個屬性。

cues.en: This is a list of messages comprising an entire conversation up to this point in time. So completions.
cues.zh: 這裡使用的是到目前為止整段對話的訊息串列，因此存取 completions。

cues.en: And then I want to create something, okay?
cues.zh: 接著我要建立聊天回覆，

cues.en: So I'm going to create this.
cues.zh: 所以呼叫 create，

cues.en: And then I'll put this on separate lines so it's more readable.
cues.zh: 再把參數分行，增加可讀性。

cues.en: First of all, what's the model?
cues.zh: 首先，使用哪個模型？

cues.en: Model is equal to self.model, right there, underscore model.
cues.zh: model 等於 self._model。

cues.en: The messages, well, that's just equal to messages, okay?
cues.zh: messages 就設為傳入的 messages，

cues.en: We get that as a call to this function.
cues.zh: 也就是呼叫這個函式時提供的訊息。

cues.en: And then streaming, that can be true or false, but we're going to make it true.
cues.zh: stream 可以是 True 或 False，但我們要設為 True。

cues.en: We want it to stream, okay?
cues.zh: 因為希望以串流方式接收。

cues.en: So I've set that up.
cues.zh: 這樣就設定好了，

cues.en: That's available to me now.
cues.zh: 現在已經可以使用。

cues.en: And now I just have a for loop.
cues.zh: 接著只要寫一個 for 迴圈。

cues.en: For, I'm going to call each pass through the loop, the data will be called a chunk.
cues.zh: 每次迴圈取得的資料，我將它命名為 chunk。

cues.en: For chunk in stream, okay?
cues.zh: 寫 for chunk in stream。

cues.en: Now each chunk has something called choices, okay?
cues.zh: 每個 chunk 都有 choices，

cues.en: And we have data in something choices at some index dot delta, which just means the change in the conversation, and then the content, okay?
cues.zh: 而資料位於 choices 某個索引項目的 delta 裡；delta 就是對話的增量，再取其中的 content。

cues.en: The first thing we want to do is to make sure we have some choices.
cues.zh: 首先要確保 choices 裡有東西。

cues.en: So we'll say if not, chunk dot choices, which I have to spell right, then we'll just continue.
cues.zh: 所以寫 if not chunk.choices，注意拼字；如果沒有就 continue，

cues.en: We'll go back to the beginning of this loop, okay?
cues.zh: 回到這個迴圈的起點。

cues.en: So that's just a safety check.
cues.zh: 這只是個安全檢查，

cues.en: And also it gets us out when we're done.
cues.zh: 也會在處理完成時跳過沒有內容的部分。

cues.en: But if we get past that, we have something called a piece, okay?
cues.zh: 但如果通過檢查，就取得一個 piece，

cues.en: A piece of the conversation.
cues.zh: 也就是對話的一小段。

cues.en: And that comes from chunk, and we'll just grab the first one, chunk at index zero dot delta dot content, okay?
cues.zh: 它來自 chunk，我們先取第一個項目，也就是索引 0，再取 .delta.content。

cues.en: So now we have the piece.
cues.zh: 現在就取得這一小段了。

cues.en: And then we have a little safety check here.
cues.zh: 接著再做一個安全檢查：

cues.en: If piece will yield piece, okay?
cues.zh: 如果 piece 有內容，就 yield piece。

cues.en: So that just goes through our stream of the conversation.
cues.zh: 這樣就能逐步處理對話串流，

cues.en: And we return an iterator so we can stream things in real time and write it to the console, okay?
cues.zh: 並以迭代器即時接收、寫到主控台。

cues.en: And it makes things seem much more responsive.
cues.zh: 感覺上就會更即時、更有反應，

cues.en: And it also allows the user to do something like control C. I don't want to wait for the whole conversation. I'm done.
cues.zh: 使用者也可以按 Ctrl+C，表示不想繼續等待，已經看夠了。

cues.en: Control C, and it quits out.
cues.zh: 按下 Ctrl+C 就會退出。

cues.en: That's all we're doing here.
cues.zh: 這裡做的就是這些。

cues.en: So this, unless I made a typo, should be all we need for now in order to initiate a connection to the LLM.
cues.zh: 所以，除非我有打錯字，否則目前這些就足以建立與 LLM 的連線。

cues.en: But of course, we have one more little thing to do.
cues.zh: 不過當然還有一小部分要做，

cues.en: And that's over here in CLI.py.
cues.zh: 就是這邊的 cli.py。

cues.en: And then we need to go get some models, and we can give this a try, okay?
cues.zh: 接著再取得一些模型，就可以試用了。

cues.en: So that's enough for this time around. Let's move on.
cues.zh: 這堂課先到這裡，我們繼續。
